design_detail: Progressive tax on very large fortunes: 1% above CHF 200m, 1.2% at CHF 500m, 1.5% at CHF 1bn (his illustration)
quote_original: Man könnte zum Beispiel sagen, dass ab 200 Millionen Franken Steuern von einem Prozent fällig werden. Bei einer halben Milliarde wären es 1,2 Prozent
quote_en: One could say, for example, that from CHF 200 million a tax of one percent falls due. At half a billion it would be 1.2 percent
source_title: Schweizer Milliardär fordert höhere Steuern für Superreiche
grading_note: B-grade: his own words as quoted by vol.at from a Tages-Anzeiger interview; he calls for higher taxes on very large wealth after the inheritance-tax initiative failed and gives a progressive rate schedule as an example ("Man könnte zum Beispiel sagen"). Date is that of the zentralplus report on the interview (1 Dec 2025); the vol.at page carries no date. He rejects an inheritance tax.

design_detail: Federal wealth tax proposed as an alternative to higher VAT or new payroll deductions to fund the 13th AHV pension and defence spending
quote_original: Wirtschaftsprofessor Marius Brülhart wirbt deshalb für eine Bundesvermögenssteuer statt höherer Mehrwertsteuer oder neuer Lohnabzüge.
quote_en: Economics professor Marius Brülhart therefore advocates a federal wealth tax instead of a higher VAT or new payroll deductions.
source_title: Brisante Wirtschaftsstudie: Neue Vermögenssteuer statt zusätzliche Lohnabgaben?
grading_note: B-grade: the sentence is the SRF reporter's summary of his position; the article adds that for him a federal wealth tax is "denkbar". No rate or threshold is given. Location is his university.

design_detail: Temporary 20% surcharge on the top bracket of the cantonal wealth tax for three years (Zurich initiative "Faire Finanzierung der Corona-Hilfen")
quote_original: Die Volksinitiative verlangt einen befristeten Zuschlag von 20 Prozent auf die höchste Progressionsstufe der Vermögenssteuer.
quote_en: The popular initiative demands a temporary surcharge of 20 percent on the highest progression bracket of the wealth tax.
source_title: Rückzug der Volksinitiative «Faire Finanzierung der Corona-Hilfen»
grading_note: B-grade: the Alternative Liste's statement on withdrawing the initiative names this body among the launching parties and unions. The initiative was withdrawn in August 2023, before a vote.

design_detail: Corona solidarity surcharge of 0.3 per mille on taxable wealth over CHF 2 million for five years (Schaffhausen initiative by SP, AL and Greens)
quote_original: Höhere Steuern auf Vermögen Reiche sollen solidarischer sein mit jenen, die wegen Corona auf dem Zahnfleisch laufen, findet SP-Kantonsrat Matthias Freivogel
quote_en: Higher taxes on wealth. The rich should show more solidarity with those struggling because of Corona, says SP cantonal councillor Matthias Freivogel
source_title: Wohlhabende zur Kasse bitten: Schaffhauser Linke fordert Corona-Steuer für Reiche
grading_note: B-grade: SRF reports his position on the initiative (a temporary surcharge on wealth over CHF 2 million); the sentence is the reporter's, with his quote "Breite und starke Schultern können mehr tragen" in the same article.

design_detail: Corona solidarity surcharge of 0.3 per mille on taxable wealth over CHF 2 million for five years (Schaffhausen initiative by SP, AL and Greens)
quote_original: Die Initiative sei ein kleiner Schritt in Richtung mehr Gerechtigkeit, sagt Marianne Wildberger von der Alternativen Liste. Für die Wohlhabenden sei eine solche höhere Besteuerung ausserdem ein Klacks.
quote_en: The initiative is a small step towards more fairness, says Marianne Wildberger of the Alternative List. For the wealthy such a higher taxation would be a trifle.
source_title: Wohlhabende zur Kasse bitten: Schaffhauser Linke fordert Corona-Steuer für Reiche
grading_note: B-grade: SRF reports her support for the surcharge initiative in indirect speech; she adds that wealthy people would "gar nichts davon merken".

design_detail: Corona solidarity surcharge of 0.3 per mille on taxable wealth over CHF 2 million for five years (Schaffhausen initiative by SP, AL and Greens)
quote_original: Vermögen von über zwei Millionen Franken … Lanciert hatte diese Initiative die SP.
quote_en: Wealth of over two million francs … The SP had launched this initiative.
source_title: Abstimmung Kanton Schaffhausen: Schaffhausen lehnt Corona-Sondersteuer ab
grading_note: B-grade: SRF reports that the SP launched the initiative, which voters rejected on 15 May 2022 with almost 69 percent against.

design_detail: Temporary solidarity levy on wealth over CHF 1 billion to fund a Covid-19 fund (motion 20.3203, submitted by the Social Democratic group)
quote_original: Dieser Fonds wird gespiesen aus einer zeitlich befristeten Solidaritätsabgabe auf sehr hohe Vermögen ab einer Milliarde Franken.
quote_en: This fund is financed by a temporary solidarity levy on very high wealth from one billion francs.
source_title: Motion 20.3203 Solidaritätsabgabe auf Milliardenvermögen zur Bekämpfung der Corona-Krise
grading_note: A-grade: motion submitted by the Social Democratic parliamentary group; the National Council rejected it on 15 March 2022 (66 yes, 126 no, see the roll call rows). Date is the submission date.

design_detail: Covid-19 solidarity tax on wealth over CHF 3 million (motion 20.3174)
quote_original: Der Bundesrat wird beauftragt, eine "Covid-19-Solidaritätssteuer" auf Vermögen von über drei Millionen einzuführen
quote_en: The Federal Council is instructed to introduce a "Covid-19 solidarity tax" on wealth of over three million
source_title: Motion 20.3174 Millionäre besteuern, um Gemeinwesen zu finanzieren und Arbeitsplätze zu retten
grading_note: A-grade: he submitted the motion (National Council rejected it on 22 September 2021, 65 yes, 118 no).

design_detail: Constitutional amendment (Art. 128) to introduce a direct federal tax on the wealth of natural persons (motion 23.3361)
quote_original: Der Bundesrat wird beauftragt, Artikel 128 der Bundesverfassung dahingehend zu ändern, dass darin die Erhebung einer direkten Steuer auf dem Vermögen natürlicher Personen eingeführt wird
quote_en: The Federal Council is instructed to amend Article 128 of the Federal Constitution so that it introduces a direct tax on the wealth of natural persons
source_title: Motion 23.3361 Für eine Steuer auf dem Vermögen der Superreichen!
grading_note: A-grade: she submitted the motion (National Council rejected it on 13 March 2024, 60 yes, 132 no).

design_detail: Temporary federal wealth tax of 1% on wealth over CHF 2 million for three years from 2021 (motion 20.3335)
quote_original: die Steuer soll auf drei Jahre befristet sein … ein Prozent des Vermögens über zwei Millionen Franken betragen
quote_en: the tax is to be limited to three years … amount to one percent of wealth above two million francs
source_title: Motion 20.3335 Eine zeitlich begrenzte solidarische Bundessteuer auf dem Vermögen
grading_note: A-grade: she submitted the motion (rejected by the National Council on 15 March 2022, 66 yes, 127 no). Date is the submission date.

design_detail: Geneva initiative IN 185: temporary solidarity contribution of 2.5 per mille on the part of a fortune above CHF 3 million for ten years (4.5 to 5 per mille with the additional cantonal and communal centimes), plus tripled social deductions
quote_original: Elle demande, pour dix ans, une contribution de 5 pour 1000 … sur la seule part de la fortune qui dépasse 3 millions
quote_en: She asks, for ten years, a contribution of 5 per 1000 … on only the part of the fortune that exceeds 3 million
source_title: Grand Conseil de Genève, séance du 1 septembre 2022: IN 185 (Pour une contribution temporaire de solidarité sur les grandes fortunes)
grading_note: B-grade: in the debate he presents and defends what the initiative asks while attacking its opponents, without a separate sentence of endorsement; he is recorded as speaker for the initiative at the opening of the debate. The party is the one printed next to his name in the minutes (EAG, Ve, S).

design_detail: Geneva initiative IN 185: temporary solidarity contribution of 2.5 per mille on the part of a fortune above CHF 3 million for ten years (4.5 to 5 per mille with the additional cantonal and communal centimes), plus tripled social deductions
quote_original: Il convient de donner un coup de pouce temporaire à travers l'impôt de solidarité sur les grandes fortunes que cette initiative propose.
quote_en: A temporary boost is called for through the solidarity tax on large fortunes that this initiative proposes.
source_title: Grand Conseil de Genève, séance du 1 septembre 2022: IN 185 (Pour une contribution temporaire de solidarité sur les grandes fortunes)
grading_note: A-grade: his own words in the Grand Conseil debate, calling for the tax the initiative proposes. The party is the one printed next to his name in the minutes (EAG, Ve, S).

design_detail: Geneva initiative IN 185: temporary solidarity contribution of 2.5 per mille on the part of a fortune above CHF 3 million for ten years (4.5 to 5 per mille with the additional cantonal and communal centimes), plus tripled social deductions
quote_original: pour le parti socialiste, cette initiative fiscale tombe à point nommé … pour que les personnes qui disposent d'une fortune de plus de 3 millions puissent contribuer modestement
quote_en: for the Socialist Party, this tax initiative comes at just the right moment … so that people with a fortune of more than 3 million can contribute modestly
source_title: Grand Conseil de Genève, séance du 1 septembre 2022: IN 185 (Pour une contribution temporaire de solidarité sur les grandes fortunes)
grading_note: A-grade: his own words in the Grand Conseil debate, speaking for the Socialist group in favour of the initiative. The party is the one printed next to his name in the minutes (EAG, Ve, S).

design_detail: Counter-proposal to IN 185 limiting the solidarity contribution on fortunes over CHF 3 million to five years, with the tripled deductions kept
quote_original: Le Conseil d'Etat a décidé de vous proposer un contreprojet pour limiter à une durée de cinq ans le premier volet … puisqu'une contribution de solidarité a été estimée nécessaire dans la situation actuelle
quote_en: The Council of State decided to propose a counter-proposal limiting the first part to five years … since a solidarity contribution was judged necessary in the present situation
source_title: Grand Conseil de Genève, séance du 1 septembre 2022: IN 185 (Pour une contribution temporaire de solidarité sur les grandes fortunes)
grading_note: B-grade: in the same debate the government's majority puts forward a counter-proposal that keeps the contribution for five years ('une contribution de solidarité a été estimée nécessaire'). It rejected the initiative as drafted (ten years), so this is partial support.

design_detail: Federal wealth tax: calls the Green Liberal proposal (0.33% on wealth over CHF 5m) a possible solution and says the rate could be somewhat higher
quote_original: Den Vorschlag der Grünliberalen – 0,33 Prozent auf Vermögen über fünf Millionen Franken – bezeichnet er als mögliche Lösung.
quote_en: He calls the Green Liberals' proposal, 0.33 percent on wealth over five million francs, a possible solution.
source_title: Toggenburger Millionenerbe fordert höhere Steuern für Superreiche
grading_note: B-grade: bluewin reports his position from a Tages-Anzeiger interview; the sentence is the reporter's, with his own quote "Die stärksten Schultern einer Gesellschaft sollen die grösste Last tragen" in the same article. He also signed the WEF appeal "We Must Draw the Line". He names a national inheritance tax or a federal wealth tax as conceivable and leaves the model to politics.

design_detail: Higher wealth tax on the richest 1% (Oxfam model: 2% for millionaires, 3% above USD 50m, 5% for billionaires); Solidar Suisse estimates the Swiss yield at USD 37.1 million a year
quote_original: Dies könne geschehen etwa durch die Erhöhung der Vermögenssteuer für das reichste ein Prozent der Welt, schrieb Solidar Suisse in einer Mitteilung.
quote_en: This could be done, for example, by raising the wealth tax on the richest one percent of the world, Solidar Suisse wrote in a statement.
source_title: WEF 2023: Oxfam und Solidar Suisse wollen gerechte Vermögenssteuer für Reiche
grading_note: B-grade: the wire report paraphrases Solidar Suisse's statement, which backs Oxfam's call for higher wealth taxes on the richest 1% and gives a Swiss figure, so it is about Switzerland as well as the world.

design_detail: St. Gallen "Steuergerechtigkeitsinitiative": replace the flat 1.7 per mille wealth-tax rate by three steps (2 per mille on parts between CHF 1m and 2m, 3 per mille above 2m)
quote_original: SP, Grüne und Gewerkschaften verlangten mit ihrer Initiative eine, wie sie meinten, gerechtere Besteuerung hoher Vermögen.
quote_en: The SP, the Greens and the unions demanded with their initiative a, as they saw it, fairer taxation of high wealth.
source_title: St. Gallen gegen höhere Vermögenssteuern
grading_note: B-grade: NZZ names the SP and the Greens (with unions) as the initiative's sponsors; the voters rejected it on 14 June 2015 with 73% against. Branch names are taken from the party names in the article.

design_detail: Neuchâtel initiative "Pour une fiscalité plus équitable": "moderate" rise of the wealth tax on fortunes above CHF 500,000 (about 1.4 per mille more, CHF 13.4m a year)
quote_original: le POP avait lancé son texte qui prévoit une hausse «modérée» de l'impôt sur les fortunes supérieures à 500’000 francs
quote_en: the POP had launched its text, which provides for a "moderate" rise in the tax on fortunes above 500,000 francs
source_title: Votations cantonales: Les Neuchâtelois doivent dire s'ils veulent taxer plus les riches
grading_note: B-grade: Le Matin reports that the POP launched the initiative; the party's own page (nouveau.pop-ne.ch, 11 Feb 2022) campaigns for it. The initiative was rejected on 15 May 2022 (57.8% no, from a search summary).

design_detail: Federal wealth tax of 0.33% on wealth above CHF 5 million (expected yield about CHF 2.7bn a year) to fund the 13th AHV pension and the army
quote_original: GLP- Nationalrat Patrick Hässig schlägt vor: Reiche sollen neu auch auf Bundesebene besteuert werden – ab einem Freibetrag von 5 Millionen Franken
quote_en: GLP National Councillor Patrick Hässig proposes that the rich should now also be taxed at federal level, above an allowance of 5 million francs
source_title: GLP fordert: Millionäre sollen Mehrkosten für AHV und Armee bezahlen
grading_note: B-grade: nau.ch reports his proposal, which he put to the Tages-Anzeiger and calls a "smarte Besteuerung"; the rate of 0.33% comes from the 20 Minuten report of 15 March 2026 (second row). Not yet a tabled motion in Curia Vista.

design_detail: Federal wealth tax of 0.33% on wealth above CHF 5 million (expected yield about CHF 2.7bn a year) to fund the 13th AHV pension and the army
quote_original: Eine «moderate Bundesvermögenssteuer» sei eine Lösung, «die den Mittelstand weniger belastet und auch beim Volk bessere Chancen hat», ist er überzeugt.
quote_en: A "moderate federal wealth tax" is a solution "that burdens the middle class less and has a better chance with the people", he is convinced.
source_title: Für Armee & AHV: Volk lehnt höhere MWST ab – und liebäugelt mit Vermögenssteuer
grading_note: B-grade: 20 Minuten reports that he sketched the plan (0.33% above CHF 5m, about CHF 2.7bn) and quotes him in favour of a moderate federal wealth tax.

design_detail: Federal wealth tax of 0.33% on wealth above CHF 5 million (expected yield about CHF 2.7bn a year) to fund the 13th AHV pension and the army
quote_original: Die GLP will eine Bundesweite Vermögenssteuer ab einem Freibetrag von 5 Millionen Franken.
quote_en: The GLP wants a nationwide wealth tax above an allowance of 5 million francs.
source_title: GLP fordert: Millionäre sollen Mehrkosten für AHV und Armee bezahlen
grading_note: B-grade: nau.ch states the party position; 20 Minuten calls it "eine neue Idee aus GLP-Kreisen", so it is the National Councillor's proposal that the news treats as the party line. Re-check against a GLP document.

design_detail: Open letter by about 200 millionaires to the leaders at Davos 2024: "tax the ultra rich"; no tax design is named
source_title: The Cost of Extreme Wealth: signatories
publisher: The Cost of Extreme Wealth (open letter)
grading_note: C-grade: the signatory list prints the name with the country code. The letter says "tax us, the ultra rich" and names no wealth tax by design; the signer's own words are not given.

design_detail: Opposes the cut of the Bern cantonal wealth tax in the tax law revision 27 and demands that revenue losses be compensated through the wealth or inheritance tax
quote_original: Andere Elemente, wie die Senkung der Vermögenssteuer oder die geplante Besteuerung von Gemeindeanstalten lehnen die GRÜNEN ab.
quote_en: Other elements, such as the cut of the wealth tax or the planned taxation of municipal institutions, the Greens reject.
source_title: Steuergesetzrevision 27: Echte Umverteilung statt Steuergeschenke für Reiche
grading_note: C-grade: the party opposes a cut of the existing wealth tax and asks for compensation through the wealth or inheritance tax; it does not call for a higher wealth tax, and the same release welcomes cuts for small incomes.

design_detail: Federal wealth tax: Alliance Sud calculates over CHF 10bn a year from a rate of 2.7% on the richest 0.1% of taxpayers; plus an end to domestic bank secrecy so the tax can be enforced
quote_original: Warum wir eine Vermögenssteuer des Bundes brauchen und das inländische Bankgeheimnis abschaffen müssen.
quote_en: Why we need a federal wealth tax and must abolish domestic bank secrecy.
source_title: «Tax the Rich» auch in der Schweiz! (Kommentar von Dominik Gross, Alliance Sud)
grading_note: A-grade: his own commentary, first published on the Alliance Sud website and republished by Infosperber with that note (the Alliance Sud page itself sits behind a bot check). Dates differ between the two copies; the Infosperber date is used.

design_detail: Federal wealth tax: Alliance Sud calculates over CHF 10bn a year from a rate of 2.7% on the richest 0.1% of taxpayers; plus an end to domestic bank secrecy so the tax can be enforced
quote_original: Gemäss Berechnungen von Alliance Sud könnte der Bund bei einer Erhöhung des Vermögenssteuersatzes auf 2,7 Prozent für die reichsten 0,1 Prozent der Steuerpflichtigen mit jährlichen Mehreinnahmen von über 10 Milliarden Franken rechnen.
quote_en: According to Alliance Sud's calculations, the Confederation could expect additional revenue of over 10 billion francs a year from raising the wealth tax rate to 2.7 percent for the richest 0.1 percent of taxpayers.
source_title: «Tax the Rich» auch in der Schweiz! (Kommentar von Dominik Gross, Alliance Sud)
grading_note: A-grade: the alliance's own commentary and calculation, published by its tax expert; it argues for a federal wealth tax as fairer than a VAT rise.

design_detail: Reintroduce a wealth tax at federal level as the fairer alternative to a VAT increase for financing army spending (consultation response)
quote_original: Als Finanzierungslösung sehen die GRÜNEN die Wiedereinführung einer Vermögenssteuer auf Bundesebene als gerechtere und sinnvollere Alternative zur Mehrwertsteuererhöhung an.
quote_en: As a financing solution the Greens see the reintroduction of a wealth tax at federal level as a fairer and more sensible alternative to a VAT increase.
source_title: Bundesbeschluss über die Finanzierung der Rüstungsausgaben der Armee durch Erhöhung der Mehrwertsteuer (Vernehmlassungsantwort)
grading_note: A-grade: the party's own consultation response to the Federal Council; no rate or threshold given. The page date (27 May 2026) is that of the response.

design_detail: Wealth tax (and inheritance tax) as fairer sources of federal revenue than raising VAT; no design given
quote_original: Für gewisse ist es einfach, die Mehrwertsteuer anzutasten und nicht beispielsweise die Erbschaftssteuer oder Vermögenssteuer, welche fairer wären für manche Investitionen.
quote_en: For some it is easy to touch the VAT and not, for example, the inheritance tax or wealth tax, which would be fairer for some investments.
source_title: Armee, AHV, Bahn: Die Mehrwertsteuer ist zur eierlegenden Wollmilchsau geworden
grading_note: B-grade: her own quoted words in SRF; she names the wealth tax as a fairer alternative to VAT without a design. Date from the date line of the SRF page (01.10.2026). She already has three roll-call rows.
